text.실행·대화 기록을 프로젝트 폴더 안에 둔다: Keeps run and conversation records inside the project folder
Conversation transcript archive (copies of session records so conversations can be resumed from another app).
text.대화 원본(도구 출력 포함)을 프로젝트 폴더에 복사해 다른 앱에서도 이어: Copies conversation transcripts (including tool output) into the project folder so they can be resumed from another app. Sign-in credentials aren't included. If you share the folder, the transcripts are shared too.
text.프로젝트 구성 폴더(.agent-console) 안 보관 폴더 이름. 구: Name of the archive folder inside the project config folder (.agent-console). The config folder's .gitignore template follows this name, and the project list reports missing lines.
Prefix removed from records space names. The rest is the project registration id.
text.한 번에 열어 두는 프로젝트 기록 DB 개수. 넘으면 오래 안 쓴 것부터: Number of project records databases kept open at once. Above it, the least recently used are closed first.
text.이 시간 동안 쓰지 않은 프로젝트 기록 DB의 연결을 닫는다. 0이면 닫: Closes connections to project records databases unused for this long. 0 means never close.
How long to wait for the lock to be released when another app is using the same records database.
How many backups made before upgrading a records database to keep.
text.다른 앱에서도 대화를 이어 가도록 세션 원본을 프로젝트 폴더에 둡니다(기: Keeps session transcripts in the project folder so conversations can be resumed from another app (on by default). If you share the folder, the transcripts are shared too.
text.폴더가 사라져 못 쓴 기록을 임시로 적어 두는, 앱 상태 폴더 안 폴더: Name of the folder inside the app state folder where records that couldn't be written (because the folder disappeared) are kept for now.
